prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1150; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented four times following a rear-end motor vehicle collision, with the initial visit occurring within hours of the incident. On first evaluation, the patient reported headache, dizziness, mild light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Neurological screening showed intact cranial nerves, normal gait, and no focal deficits, while a standardized concussion symptom scale indicated moderate symptom burden. A diagnosis of concussion without loss of consciousness was made, and the patient was advised on cognitive and physical rest, avoidance of screen overuse, and gradual return to daily activities.

At the second and third visits, headache frequency had decreased, but neck stiffness and intermittent dizziness with head movement persisted. Vestibular and cervical range-of-motion exercises were introduced, and the patient reported improved sleep and tolerance for reading. Cognitive symptoms were reassessed and showed steady improvement.

At the fourth visit, the patient reported most symptoms had resolved, with only occasional mild neck discomfort. Examination was unremarkable. The patient was cleared for full activity with instructions to return if symptoms recurred. Prognosis is good, with an expected full recovery.
